key_facts: Joint Interagency Task Force 401 awarded Kaizen a $15 million contract in early May to prototype a Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems Marketplace.
In April, JIATF 401 reported $13 million worth of counter-drone purchases from the marketplace, and as of the article's publication the total value of marketplace purchases sits at $21 million.
Anduril, SMARTSHOOTER, DroneShield and Aerovironment are currently posting their products to the marketplace.
Kaizen built and deployed the marketplace system, which went live two weeks before the article, from a 'blank slate' in less than nine weeks.
Foreign military participants publicly disclosed include Australia, Poland, the Republic of Korea, United Kingdom and Romania.
